stateDiagram-v2
state "Running harness" as Running
state "Waiting for input" as WaitingInput
state "Waiting for approval" as WaitingApproval
state "Pausing at safe points" as Pausing
state "Paused with acknowledged checkpoint" as Paused
state "Cancelling scoped work" as Cancelling
state "Worker generation unavailable" as Crashed
state "Rehydrating logical state" as Recovering
state "Inspectably blocked" as Blocked
state "Terminal Run" as Terminal

[*] --> Running: committed Start or Restore control
Running --> WaitingInput: Wait node and suspension checkpoint proposed
WaitingInput --> WaitingInput: more ordinary input remains FIFO in core queue
WaitingInput --> Running: committed next input delivered once and context revised
Running --> WaitingApproval: broker commits approval request
WaitingApproval --> Running: committed approved, denied, expired, or cancelled outcome
Running --> Pausing: generation-fenced pause control
WaitingInput --> Pausing: pause while already suspended
WaitingApproval --> Pausing: pause while approval is pending
Pausing --> Paused: active tasks quiesced and checkpoint acknowledged
Paused --> Running: generation-fenced resume control
Running --> Cancelling: cancel control propagates to nodes, children, and invocation scopes
WaitingInput --> Cancelling: cancel control
WaitingApproval --> Cancelling: cancel control
Paused --> Cancelling: cancel control
Cancelling --> Terminal: cancellations settle or terminal uncertainty is committed
Running --> Terminal: completion or failure transition committed
Running --> Crashed: worker exits or generation is fenced off
WaitingInput --> Crashed: worker exits
WaitingApproval --> Crashed: worker exits
Pausing --> Crashed: worker exits
Paused --> Crashed: worker exits
Cancelling --> Crashed: worker exits
Crashed --> Recovering: core sends exact snapshot, validated checkpoint, cursor, and reconciliation facts
Recovering --> Running: hashes and committed cursor match before scheduler admission
Recovering --> WaitingInput: restored committed wait frontier
Recovering --> WaitingApproval: restored committed approval frontier
Recovering --> Paused: restored committed pause frontier
Recovering --> Cancelling: restored committed cancellation frontier
Recovering --> Blocked: corruption, gap, incompatibility, or exhausted supervision budget
Blocked --> Recovering: explicit validated repair and new recovery generation
Terminal --> [*]
note right of Recovering
  Restore pure Aworkit reducers only.
  Discard unacknowledged worker state.
  Never replay a model, tool, file, shell,
  MCP, or external-agent effect.
end note
note right of Cancelling
  Cancellation does not undo workspace effects.
  An unconfirmed remote cancellation may remain uncertain.
end note

data.title: Wait, Pause, Cancel, Crash, and No-Replay Recovery
